pageindex_flash.final_answer:
Disney reported **124.6 million total Disney+ subscribers** (rounded to 125 million in the press release headline) as of December 28, 2024 — a **decrease of about 0.7 million (–1%) versus Q4 fiscal 2024** (125.3 million as of September 28, 2024).

Breakdown of the sequential change (per page 6):

| Disney+ | Dec 28, 2024 | Sep 28, 2024 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Domestic (U.S. & Canada) | 56.8M | 56.0M | +1% |
| International | 67.8M | 69.3M | –2% |
| **Total Disney+** | **124.6M** | **125.3M** | **–1%** |

Two contextual notes from the report:
- The domestic gain was more than offset by the international decline, with the drop driven largely by the Star India Transaction (Disney+ Hotstar was deconsolidated into the Reliance joint venture and is no longer reported separately).
- The prior-quarter (Q4 FY24) figures were adjusted to include Disney+ subscribers in Southeast Asia, which were previously reported under Disney+ Hotstar.

For reference, combined Disney+ and Hulu subscriptions were 178 million, up 0.9 million sequentially.
